rounds.text: Cadsys (India) Ltd is demonstrating a powerful, accelerating inflection in its underlying financial performance that the current market price fails to appreciate [E50]. This is evidenced by a phenomenal 224% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months, vastly outpacing the sector median profit growth of 11.3% [E18, E65]. The top-line momentum matches this earnings explosion, with compounded sales growth reaching 42% over the trailing twelve months alongside positive year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter increases [E14, E56, E57]. Furthermore, longer-term metrics show a decisive turnaround from historical stagnation, delivering a 21% compounded sales growth and a 46% compounded profit growth over the last 5 years [E12, E16]. Trading at a price-to-book ratio of 1.22x—and as low as 1.05x against a sector benchmark of 1.51x—the valuation remains remarkably modest given that recent profit growth exceeds one-year price growth by 233% [E2, E6, E50]. Conceded: the 10-year compounded sales growth is 0% and profit growth is -11%, reflecting a difficult historical baseline, while return metrics such as an ROE of 3.62% and ROCE of 5.8% trail sector benchmarks [E7, E8, E11, E15].
